comparison.objective: Remove a loaded drawer using paired slide releases versus commission a robot-axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Simultaneously operate two spring releases and support/extract a fragile load versus recessed key use, counterhold, fine rotation, locking, and response-based retuning.
comparison.success_condition: Drawer removed level, released, contents retained and intact versus two quantified safe stops with no hard-stop contact or collar drift.
comparison.reason: Paired release and loaded extraction do not test parameter tuning or setting retention.
